post.title: Your mortgage rate follows this number, not the Fed
post.ig:
Your mortgage rate follows one number, and it's not the Fed's.

On September 24, 2026, the 10-year Treasury yield was 5.18% and Freddie Mac's average 30-year mortgage rate was 7.03%.
The gap between them is the spread: it averaged 2.85 points in 2023 and 1.98 in 2026 through September.
Example: on a $300,000, 30-year loan, 7.03% is about $2,002 a month; 8.03% is about $2,208.

Sources: Freddie Mac PMMS, US Treasury, Fannie Mae, HousingWire spread data.
